text:
ana: Heads up — telemetry cost spike in EU after yesterday's rollout. span volume ~3x. Notable increase in short live spans from client side. Anyone seen this pattern before?
rome: Yep saw the same in traces dashboard. Most noise on /api/generate and /api/embeds routes. Likely our client SDK started sending debug spans for each retry. :grimacing: 
ana: I don't see any debug flag flips in the release notes. Could be sampling change upstream?
sahil: Quick idea — can we do dynamic head/tail sampling per tenant? Head sampling for majority, tail sampling for large requests to preserve rare failure traces.
maggie: +1. We already tag spans with tenant.id and route. We could signaled-sample at edge and do a tail-handoff to collectors for interesting traces. Need to think about memory and cost.
li: Implementation sketch: keep probabilistic head sampler at SDK (0.5% default) that sends most spans with sampled=false. For spans with high latency / error / large token_count tag, mark as candidate and push a lightweight key to a redis reservoir for tail decision. Collector does a tail-pass and pulls full span payloads if selected.
rome: That aligns with prior ideas but two blockers: 1) OTLP exporter semantics expect sampled=true to populate parent/trace flags; 2) bandwidth still used if we push full span before decision.
sahil: Proposal to avoid pushing full payload: send a small "candidate envelope" with trace_id, tenant.id, route, latency_ms, token_count, error_flag. Collector retains for lookback window (e.g., 30s) and requests the full batch only when a tail rule triggers. Client keeps full span buffer for that short TTL.
nana: Example pseudo-config for SDK we can test:
```yaml
notel: 
  exporter: otlp
  sampler: dynamic_head_tail
  dynamic_head_tail:
    head_prob: 0.005 # cheap coverage
    tail_lookback_ms: 30000
    tail_rules:
      - when: latency_ms > 1000 or error == true or token_count > 10000
        action: promote
```
rome: We should also support per-tenant weights: large customers get higher tail budget so we don't lose signal on important accounts. e.g. tenant_weights map and a reservoir quota per tenant.
maggie: Dashboards: need new heatmap for candidate->promoted ratio, and per-tenant retention meters. Also update cost estimation dashboard so sales can see telemetry consumption impact for Dedicated/Private.
li: Implementation pitfalls: 1) buffering might increase memory on clients; cap per-route buffer size. 2) network retries for candidate envelopes must be idempotent. 3) security: candidate envelope must not contain PII.
sahil: For canary we should: 1) implement SDK spike with candidate envelopes + local buffer, 2) run collector tail process behind feature flag in EU cluster, 3) enable per-tenant weight=0 for low-tier during canary.
obs-bot: deploy/telemetry-tail-spike: canary triggered in eu-staging at 2026-03-10T17:22:30Z by sahil (refs: deploy-4567) :rocket:
ana: Action items: sahil to own SDK spike, li to prototype redis reservoir + collector tailer, maggie to add dashboard panels, rome to write short RFC on sampling guarantees. Let's also add an eval set for coverage to ensure we still hit error traces.
rome: One more note — we must keep a small always-sampled fraction (e.g. 1 in 100k spans) globally for statistical baselines.
maggie: Acked. I'll also update billing docs to call out telemetry tiers.
sahil: I'll open PR for SDK prototype tomorrow and tag owners. Expect quick perf numbers by EOW. :eyes:
ana: Thanks all — good plan. We'll reconvene after the spike results. :thumbsup:
